symptom: `create or modify microflow` of a flow holding `$A = find $L where Code = 'x'` (or `filter … where` with a bare member) and one real change next to it was refused under mdl 1 — 'replace $N: the fragment declares $A, which the microflow already has' — and rebuilt whole (MDL-V1-REBUILD) under mdl 0; away from the change the find was needlessly replaced on every run. An unchanged re-run was still 'Unchanged'
cause: The builder stores a bare member of a find/filter-by-expression predicate as `$currentObject/<member>` (qualifyIteratorAttributes, #1002) and describe prints the stored form, so the statement as the script spells it never matched its own stored activity in the statement diff; the unchanged re-run escaped only because builtAsStored compares built graphs before the statement diff runs
fix: describedMemberSpellings rewrites a find/filter-by-expression predicate with the builder's own qualifyIteratorAttributes before the statement diff, keeping the predicate as written when the builder would refuse it
insight: A spelling the builder normalises is invisible to the identity check (an unchanged re-run passes) and only shows when a REAL change elsewhere sends the flow to the statement diff, so the probe that finds these is: create each flow, re-run it with one inserted statement, and flag any summary other than '1 inserted'. Over 02-microflow-examples (118 flows) and 23 hand-picked respellings this was the only clause left; sort without asc, member qualification, association spelling in expressions, `<>`, aggregates (stored as written) all matched
